title: Introducing Passi Finance: accounts, spending and budgets in one place
summary: Passi Finance brings bank transactions, spending categories and monthly budgets into one view, with Passi sign-in and an optional demo to explore the service.
bodyMarkdown:
[Passi Finance](https://finance.passi.cloud/) brings personal expense analysis to the Passi family. Review your accounts and transactions, organize spending into categories, and follow your monthly budgets.

## A clearer view of your spending

- Connect Swedbank through Enable Banking with your consent and choose which accounts to monitor.
- Review monthly spending and account activity.
- Organize transactions into categories and split a purchase across several categories.
- Set monthly category budgets and see what remains or is over budget.
- Use the interface in English, Estonian or Russian.

## Try the demo

Open [finance.passi.cloud](https://finance.passi.cloud/) and choose Demo to explore a temporary sandbox. Demo data is not saved permanently. Personal account access uses Passi sign-in and is restricted.

Bank data is accessed only with your consent. The service does not sell personal data, use it for advertising or initiate payments. See the [privacy notice](https://finance.passi.cloud/privacy) for details.
